title: Fixed Open Three Plate Frame and Opaque Optic Linen Tester
description: One newly authored complete fixed linen-tester-inspired textile and print-inspection frame exterior. Three whole thick plates form an open-front C arrangement: a flat lower plate has a genuinely full-through rectangular counting-field opening; the upright rear plate has its own large true rectangular window; and the upper plate surrounds an actual circular optic seat. One full softly biconvex opaque dark optical-appearance body occupies that upper seat. Four complete hinge-barrel exteriors and two whole headed transverse pins define both plate joints. All numeric plate openings, full convex optic profile, hinge barrels and pin profiles are independently authored. Unlike the older column microscope, there is no heavy base, upright focus column, long optical tube, objective, specimen platform or focus wheel; this is a compact three-plate folding-frame organization, not a reduced microscope. Unlike the two-leaf cord dial, it has no upright dial face, blind compass cup, needle or diagonal cord, but an upper optic aligned over an open lower measuring field. No old lenses, plates, boxes, book leaves, clocks or mesh fragments imported or extracted. Ten closed whole editable meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One independent model zero scenes. Generic unbranded inspection-tool appearance with invented dimensions and blank surfaces; not a product replica or verified folding design. The lens is deliberately opaque, not optical glass, a transparent viewport or a view of magnified fabric. No magnification, focusing, measuring scale, calibrated field size, thread counting, image formation, cloth or print quality evaluation, authentication, folding movement, hinge fit, human suitability, manufacture or safety capability made or verified. No labels, ticks, fabric, rigging, animation or interaction.
